text:
tara: quick flag - eu1 steady 5xx increase after last rollout (model-redwood-3.2.1). Not yet customer-wide but SLOs trending. Need rapid mitigation options.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Alert: eu1 5xx=10.9% over 7m. Canary fraction: 11%. Active model: model-redwood-3.2.1. Suggested: regional pin to previous model or rollback image. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/fast-rollback
mike: looking at traces - repeated GPU alloc failures and KV cache pressure.

eli: Can we do a region-only pin to 3.1.9 and skip canary to avoid global churn? We'll run a quick 20-case smoke.

ops-lead: Policy: if sustained 5xx >=10% -> mitigate. I approve expedited regional pin to v3.1.9 for eu1. Notify support.

tara: Issuing command: `/deploy pin model-redwood-3.1.9 --region eu1 --skip-canary --reason "post-release 5xx spike" --ticket INC-3510`
deploy-bot: Pin command received from tara. Validating permissions... Preflight OK. Rolling model-redwood-3.1.9 to 100% in eu1 with short ramp.
mike: running smoke now. Pausing traffic to canary pool during validation.
mike: smoke results: generation sanity + latency checks OK. No new 5xx in smoke set.
deploy-bot: Pin complete. model-redwood-3.1.9 active in eu1. 5xx rolling avg down to 0.8% over 3m; p95 latency normalized. Notifying on-call.
support-agent: CS notified and draft customer blurb created re: potential minor tokenization diffs.

releasebot: Drafted release note: "Emergency regional pin: eu1 -> v3.1.9 to mitigate increased 5xx following v3.2.1 rollout. Investigation ongoing. Postmortem INC-3510." PR: https://go/redwood/prs/5233

ops-lead: Keep region pinned for 2 hours, collect GPU/heap dumps from affected pods, and schedule postmortem.
tara: Filed INC-3510 and assigned follow-ups (telemetry, canary gating). I'll monitor metrics for the next 60m and reopen if needed. Thanks everyone for the fast path.
